description: Implementation of QuicClientMessageLoopNetworkHelper class for managing UDP socket communication and packet processing in a QUIC client context.

classes.name: QuicClientMessageLooplNetworkHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing UDP socket communication and packet processing in a QUIC client.

methods.name: CreateUDPSocketAndBind
methods.description: Creates and binds a UDP socket to the specified server address and local port.

methods.name: CleanUpAllUDPSockets
methods.description: Cleans up and resets UDP socket and packet reader resources.

methods.name: StartPacketReaderIfNotStarted
methods.description: Starts the packet reader if it has not been started yet.

methods.name: RunEventLoop
methods.description: Runs the event loop to process network events.

methods.name: CreateQuicPacketWriter
methods.description: Creates a new QuicChromiumPacketWriter for sending packets.

methods.name: OnReadError
methods.description: Handles read errors on the socket, disconnecting the client.

methods.name: GetLatestClientAddress
methods.description: Returns the latest client address used.
